name: Valeria Quispe
bio: Valeria is a vibrant and passionate artist from Lima, known for her colorful murals and bold abstract paintings that often explore themes of identity and social justice. A graduate of a local trades school specializing in mural art, she now makes a comfortable living selling her art, accepting commissions, and running workshops for aspiring artists. Valeria is an adventurous soul who loves exploring new places and cultures, but also values her close-knit community and active social life. She's looking for a partner who can keep up with her energetic lifestyle and appreciate her artistic vision, someone who's confident, supportive, and doesn't shy away from a little bit of drama.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled in a high ponytail or loose braids with colorful beads woven in.
physical.description: Valeria has a striking face with high cheekbones and a warm smile. Her signature look includes bold, colorful makeup that accentuates her expressive eyes.

meetingContext: At an art exhibition sponsored by one of your team's partners.
firstImpression: Her infectious laughter and the way she animatedly discusses art with a group of people across the room immediately draw your attention; she commands the space effortlessly.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Valeria shows her love by doing things for her partner, whether it's cooking a meal or helping with a project. She appreciates it when her partner reciprocates with practical support and assistance.
